newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon declines comment on Scot Amicable.
newsitem.headline: Aegon declines comment on Scot Amicable.

text.p: Dutch insurance group Aegon on Tuesday declined to comment on reports that it was one of the frontrunners to buy UK life insurance mutual Scottish Amicable.
"We have no comment on this. It's just one of those market rumours," said Aegon spokesman Ewold de Bruijne.
However, he added Aegon was interested in acquiring insurance companies in markets which it was familiar with.
"It's clear that Aegon has a strategy of acquiring companies in those countries where we already have an interest.
Aegon has an 80 percent stake in the UK's Scottish Equitable. It also has interests in the United States, Hungary and Spain as well as the Netherlands.
On Tuesday, ratings agency Standard and Poor's said the Aegon and Australian Mutual Provident were among the favourites to buy Scottish Amicable.
Speculation over the future of Scottish Amicable came after last week's offer of 1.4 billion stg from Abbey National.
